'''Moff Jarnek's palace''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spirador]] in the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]]. This was [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlov Jarnek]]'s primary residence. The [[Covallon]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Dælar vuv Tertarrnek]], who masqueraded as Jarnek's pet, also spent much time here. It was from this location that he sent coded transmissions to an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] probot in the [[Spirador system/Legends|Spirador system]].
